summary: The deprecations return key holds a list of dictionaries with msg and version keys that Ansible presents to the user as deprecation warnings.
questions: How does a module emit a deprecation warning?
What format do deprecations in module results use?

answer_card.title: deprecations return key
answer_card.answer_md: **`deprecations`** is a list of `{msg, version}` dicts (strings; `version` may be empty) that Ansible shows as deprecation warnings. In modules, use `module.deprecate(msg, version=...)` instead of building it yourself.
